purpose: Autonomous HB (.hbosc) finds a Van der Pol LC oscillator's frequency

oracle.derivation: Row 1 is the fundamental. ngspice-45 transient of the same tank from .ic v(t)=0.01 (uic), 300 us at a 0.5 ns step: rising v(t)=0 crossings 100..250 are 1.00057 us apart; a 0.2 ns step gives the same digits. Van der Pol, eps = 6e-4*sqrt(L/C) = 0.095, so the shift below 1/(2*pi*sqrt(LC)) = 1 MHz is about eps^2/16.
